title: sch02_timer_polling_test: skip-locked count is 0 and forced-failure rollback does not surface TransactionFailed (2 blocks)
summary: TC-SCH-02-02 expects skipped_locked > 0 but gets 0. TC-SCH-02-03 expects pollDueTimers() to surface error.TransactionFailed after a forced idempotency_key collision, but the poller returns a normal zero-work result.
root_cause_hypothesis: poller silently swallows forced DB error rather than surfacing it
collision setup does not commit before pollDueTimers runs (commit-visibility)
poller never attempts to fire the timer for an unrelated reason
row-lock not held by concurrent-locker helper used in test
poller SKIP LOCKED query not hitting the intended row
acceptance_criteria: TC-SCH-02-02 skip-locked path traced; lock confirmed held; query correctly excludes locked rows
TC-SCH-02-03 forced-failure path traced; collision commits before polling; pollDueTimers surfaces underlying DB error
Both tests pass against a freshly migrated database
